summary: Minor or disabled children, a disabled spouse and parents are guaranteed half of their intestate share. Ukraine has no trust law and is outside the Hague Trusts Convention. Choice of foreign law is unconfirmed.
reserved_share: Minor or disabled children, disabled spouse and parents: not less than 1/2 of the intestate share; Civil Code art. 1241.
foreign_law_note: The 2005 Law on Private International Law applies the law of the deceased's last domicile (law of location for immovables); a choice of national law was not confirmed.
trust_note: Only property management contracts exist, not trusts. Foundations exist mainly as charitable bodies under the Civil Code.
open_questions: Art. 1241 text and the conflict articles of the 2005 law.
Wartime and martial-law effects on inheritance.
Any planned trust or foundation legislation.
